name: pets-p4
description: Pet program Stage P4 (other pets): a small-pets room injected on the living-room floor — a bird cage on a stand + a tabletop bird play gym, a rabbit hutch (two-zone: solid sleeping box + wire run), a C&C guinea-pig pen, a hamster glass tank on a stand, and an aquarium stand + water tank against a wall. Screenshots: the room wide, then an aquarium closeup (water/glass must read), a cage closeup (wire must read at cage scale) and the hutch (two-zone must be visible).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: compute-room-anchors
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const fp = st.floorPlan; const room = fp.rooms.find(r => r.id === st.roomEditor.roomId) || fp.rooms.find(r => r.id === 'livingDining'); if (!room) throw new Error('no living/dining room'); const ox = room.origin[0], oz = room.origin[1], W = room.width, D = room.depth; window.__room = { ox, oz, W, D, cx: ox + W/2, cz: oz + D/2 }; })()

steps.name: inject-small-pets-room
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const r = window.__room; const at = (defId, fx, fz, rotation, props) => ({ id: defId + '-p4', defId, position: [r.ox + r.W*fx, r.oz + r.D*fz], rotation: rotation || 0, props: props || {} }); const items = [ at('bird-cage', 0.16, 0.2, 0, { size: 'M', mount: 'stand', shape: 'dome' }), at('bird-play-gym', 0.32, 0.22, 0, {}), at('rabbit-hutch', 0.62, 0.2, 0, { width: 1.35, depth: 0.6, height: 0.9 }), at('small-pet-pen', 0.3, 0.6, 0, { gridsX: 3, gridsY: 2 }), at('hamster-tank', 0.62, 0.62, 0, { size: 'M', base: 'stand' }), { id: 'aquarium-stand-p4', defId: 'aquarium-stand', position: [r.ox + r.W*0.88, r.oz + r.D*0.5], rotation: -Math.PI/2, props: { tankLength: '1.2', doors: 'yes' } } ]; st.setItems(items); window.__aqC = [r.ox + r.W*0.88, r.oz + r.D*0.5]; window.__cageC = [r.ox + r.W*0.16, r.oz + r.D*0.2]; window.__hutchC = [r.ox + r.W*0.62, r.oz + r.D*0.2]; })()

steps.name: assert-all-placed
steps.eval: (function(){ const ids = window.__store.getState().items.map(i => i.defId); for (const id of ['bird-cage','bird-play-gym','rabbit-hutch','small-pet-pen','hamster-tank','aquarium-stand']) { if (!ids.includes(id)) throw new Error('missing item: ' + id); } console.log('small-pets room: ' + ids.join(', ')); })()

steps.name: frame-room-wide
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[r.ox + r.W*0.5, 0.6, r.oz + r.D*0.42], radius:4.2}); })()
